purpose: Test whether the residual effective numerator coefficient c2 is materially required after the documented Magnicon XXF-1 10 kHz second-order Bessel LPF is explicit and c4 is fixed to zero.
guardrail: The XXF-1 manual documents the 10 kHz +/-2.5% second-order Bessel output LPF, but the filter state during the 2024-12-05/06 acquisition is still unknown. This diagnostic tests whether phenomenological c2 is needed conditional on the LPF-ON hypothesis. c4 is fixed to zero in every Magnicon branch. No production data or production noise model are modified.
